sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Dronabinol is the synthetic form of delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC), the major active component of cannabis. Low levels of THC are found in the breastmilk of mothers who use cannabis products. If a mother requires dronabinol, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding, but because no published information is available with dronabinol use as an antiemetic during breastfeeding, an alternate antiemetic is preferred. For further information, see the LactMed record on Cannabis.
